title: provider.read_licence gives CC BY-SA to a gitlab-org/gitlab doc/ path with a double-encoded .. segment
goal: provider.read_licence unquotes the path of a gitlab-org/gitlab doc/ url until it no longer changes before it looks for a .. segment, so .../doc/%252e%252e/app/x.rb keeps the API's MIT. Found by the SP-c6tr77jl review (S4, BG-iwqv7nxs).

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import provider as p;p.request=lambda *a,**k:{"status":404,"error":"x","body":b"","headers":{}};l=p.read_licence("https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/blob/master/doc/%252e%252e/app/x.rb")["licence"];print(l);sys.exit(1 if l.startswith("CC BY-SA") else 0)
